description: This file defines the CustomFieldAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, providing REST API endpoints for managing custom fields in the PIM module. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting custom fields, along with validation rules and documentation annotations.

classes.name: CustomFieldAPI
classes.description: A REST API class providing endpoints for CRUD operations on custom fields within the PIM module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific custom field by its ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all custom fields, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new custom field, enforcing a maximum of 10 fields.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified custom fields if they are not in use.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a single custom field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validation rules for listing custom fields.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a new custom field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a custom field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deleting custom fields.

methods.name: setCustomField
methods.description: Sets the properties of a CustomField object based on request parameters.

methods.name: saveCustomField
methods.description: Saves a CustomField object to the database after setting its properties.
